capacity_insufficient: Insufficient capacity: {deficit} inhabitants cannot be placed with the current maximum densities.
dmax_increase_not_approved: Raising the maximum densities by {increase} % would make room for them; this increase was not approved.
dmax_raised: Maximum densities raised by {increase} % on {units} units.
dmax_impossible: No increase of the maximum densities can make room for the population: the units allowed to receive population have no area.
no_convergence_no_receivers: Migration did not converge (no unit has free capacity left): {excess} inhabitants in excess.
no_convergence_max_iterations: Migration did not converge (maximum number of iterations reached: {max_iterations}): {excess} inhabitants in excess.
recorded_as_unallocated: {excess} inhabitants are recorded as unallocated population.
sink_insufficient: The ring of sink cells is not large enough to place the whole population.
sink_placed: {placed} inhabitants placed in the ring of sink cells.
scenario_invalid_json: The scenario file {path} is not valid JSON: {detail}
scenario_projection_needs_data: Scenario: starting from a projection or recalibrating on projections requires a projection file and an administrative units layer.
scenario_dated_outside: Scenario: the exclusion "{name}" is "outside" with an effective year; use "relocate" or "no_inflow" instead.
typology_gaps: {area} km² of the study area are covered by no typology zone; the default value "*" of the parameters applies there.
start_from_projection: Start on the projection year {year}: base population scaled to the projected totals.
resolution_coarse_cell: Calculation cell ({cell} m) coarser than the population raster ({pixel} m): first-approach result, to be refined.
resolution_coarse_time: Migration computed every {step} years (not every year): faster but coarser distribution; first-approach result, to be refined.
exclusion_frozen: Zone "{name}" closed to migration from {year}: its growth is now exported.
run_canceled: Run canceled by the user in {year}.
run_population: Population: {start} at the start, {end} at the final horizon
crs_not_metric: The calculation coordinate system must be projected in metres ("{crs}" is not). Choose for example a UTM zone, or "auto-utm".
crs_area_distortion: This coordinate system distorts areas by up to {distortion} % over the study area. An equal-area system is recommended ("crs": "auto-equal-area").
raster_reprojected: Population raster reprojected to {name} ({pixel} m pixels) by area-weighted averaging of densities; total population difference due to the raster edges: {correction} %.
exclusion_needs_buffer: Exclusion zone “{name}”: the layer holds lines or points; give a buffer width in metres.
parameter_key_unused: Parameter “{parameter}”: the value “{key}” matches no zone of its layer within the study area; it is not used.
roofs_calibrated: Starting population computed from the roofs: {kept} roofs kept out of {read}, {population} inhabitants.
roofs_unknown_usage: Roofs: the usage category “{category}” is not in the table of coefficients; the default value applies.
html_unknown_usage: Usage categories missing from the table (default coefficient)
html_alert: Gap beyond ±{alert} %: adjust the classes or recalibrate.
html_legend_distribution: Bars: roofs per m² of area; line: inhabitants per roof (right scale); ochre lines: class limits.
html_legend_cumulative: Cumulated share of the roofs (grey) and of the population (petrol) by roof area; ochre lines: class limits.
html_overridden: Coloured cells: values changed by hand.
html_regression: Regression on the strata: R² = {r2}, root mean square error {rmse} inhabitants, mean relative error {mape} %.
html_diagnostics: Increasing curve: {monotone} · share of roofs at the ceiling: {capped} %.
html_footer: Report produced on {date} · Poplar engine {engine} · GDAL {gdal}
file_not_found_layer: Layer not found or not reachable: {path}. Check the layers of the Data, Parameters and Calibration tabs.
file_not_found_raster: Population raster (Data tab) not found or not reachable: {path}.
file_not_found_roofs: Roof layer (Calibration tab) not found or not reachable: {path}.
file_not_found_exclusion: Exclusion zone “{name}” (Data tab) not found or not reachable: {path}.
file_not_found_projections: Projection file (Data tab) not found or not reachable: {path}.
raster_ignored: Population raster not found ({path}): ignored, the starting population comes from the roofs.
input_typology.field: the class field, right of the typology (Data tab)
input_admin_units.field: the field of the administrative units (Data tab)
input_base_population: the starting population: a raster (Data tab) or the roofs (Calibration tab)
input_base_population.raster: the population raster (Data tab), or check “Starting population computed from the roofs” (Calibration tab)
input_time.start_year: the start year on the projections (Data tab)
input_parameters: the growth rate and maximum densities (Parameters tab)
